paras: Ternary is an engineering institution. We build digital systems for organizations scaling operations and transforming infrastructure—from concepts to launch, legacy to cloud.

Headquartered in New York with a delivery hub in Dhaka, we operate as technical partners responsible for the systems we design, deliver, and maintain over time. This is software development approached as long-term stewardship: built not just to launch, but to perform reliably and evolve thoughtfully.

about.heading: Engineering for enduring impact
about.description: We establish an engineering partnership model rooted in technical excellence and sustained accountability, where success is measured by durability and operational impact over years, not solely by launch velocity.

organizations.heading: Trusted by operators across the experience, financial, and industrial economies

about.bottomDescription: Our global delivery hub acts as a unified center of excellence—creating operational continuity, preserving institutional knowledge, and establishing scalable execution capacity across every client engagement.

solutions.heading: Concepts to launch, legacy to cloud
solutions.description: Three ways we engage, one standard of ownership. We design and build new products, modernize the systems organizations have outgrown, and extend established teams with senior engineering talent.

capabilities.heading: Capabilities
capabilities.description: Data and analytics, artificial intelligence, cloud transformation, digital experiences, platforms, and the Internet of Things. We build modern technical solutions that drive measurable business value.
capabilities.description_2: Our teams operate under experienced technical leadership with clearly defined expectations around accountability, code quality, professional growth, and delivery outcomes.

industries.heading: Domain expertise across every industry
industries.description: We serve banking and capital markets, financial services, advanced manufacturing, sports, entertainment, hospitality, travel, consumer goods, and technology platforms worldwide.

scales.heading: Scales served
scales.description: From early-stage startups building MVPs to scale-ups expanding infrastructure, mid-market firms modernizing systems, and enterprises transforming operations—plus government and defense.

engagement.heading: Predictive delivery, total control
engagement.description: Frame™ for fixed-scope projects. Flow™ for continuous delivery and ongoing partnerships. Orchestra™ for on-demand talent augmentation. Three engagement models, one commitment to outcomes.

globalDelivery.heading: Secure global delivery hubs
globalDelivery.description: New York headquarters and Dhaka delivery hub. Distributed teams with centralized quality standards. ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certified, SOC 2 compliant, with rigorous processes ensuring excellence.
globalDelivery.title: Our global delivery hub
globalDelivery.excerpt: A centralized engineering institution designed to develop talent, scale execution capability, and sustain quality standards over time. We combine structured talent development, experienced technical leadership, disciplined execution frameworks, and long-term operational infrastructure to deliver with consistency at scale.

processes.heading: How we operate
processes.description: A centralized institution built for long-term quality—four foundations that let us deliver complex, mission-critical systems with consistency.

paras: A unified center of engineering excellence that creates operational continuity, preserves institutional knowledge, and establishes scalable execution capacity across teams and client engagements.

We identify high-potential engineering talent early and systematically develop capabilities through rigorous technical training, structured mentorship, and engineering standards aligned to our long-term quality requirements.
Our teams operate under experienced technical leadership with clearly defined expectations around accountability, code quality, professional growth, and delivery outcomes.

We invest in the foundational systems of durable engineering excellence: talent acquisition, technical training programs, delivery governance, career progression frameworks, and leadership development.
We maintain full production responsibility across the entire system lifecycle—actively supporting deployments and remaining accountable for sustained performance long after launch.

team.heading: Unified collective
team.description: From cloud-native architecture to RevOps optimization, our team operates with total ownership. We ship the technical and commercial infrastructure that powers modern enterprise.

opportunities.heading: Construct the future
opportunities.description: Technical execution aligned with business objectives—partnerships that extend beyond delivery into sustained development and support. If you are building or modernizing systems that have to last, let's talk.
